summary: Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Trust 2026-5C9 filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Pooling and Servicing Agreement dated May 1, 2026, for the issuance of commercial mortgage pass-through certificates. The trust's assets are 29 fixed-rate mortgage loans and subordinate interests in two loans secured by 138 commercial properties. The filing describes routine securitization activities, including details on the whole loan structure for The Towers at Cupertino City Center, which involves pari passu notes not held by the trust. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present; this is a standard current report for a new issuance.
